name: Palmistry
overview: Scripture clearly condemns practices such as palmistry as forms of divination and enchantment that lead believers away from God. The Old Testament repeatedly instructs God’s people not to seek after wizards, familiar spirits, or soothsayers, warning that such pursuits defile the soul and provoke God's judgment. These prohibitions emphasize reliance on the Lord alone rather than occult practices, underscoring the call to holiness and separation from pagan customs that were prevalent among surrounding nations.
